resources.string: "Quire Cloud is coming soon"
"We\'re not ready to take cloud sign-ups yet. For now, you can connect to a self-hosted calibre-web or quire_server, or use Quire entirely offline."
"Paste the URL of your calibre-web or Quire server. We\'ll figure out which one it is."
"We couldn\'t recognize that server"
"Check the URL (including any subpath) and try again."
"Quire can browse, download and read from this catalog, and it will remember your place on this device."
"Reading progress won\'t sync between devices, and the AI features stay off: both of those need a Quire server, which this catalog doesn\'t provide."
"If this is a calibre-web server, go back and enter its address instead of the feed URL, and you\'ll get sync too."
"This catalog asked for a username and password."
"Two account types detected"
"This URL looks like both a calibre-web and a Quire server. Which account do you want to use?"
"calibre-web (username + password)"
"Quire server (email + password)"
"Unexpected verification result."
"That URL answered, but it isn\'t an OPDS catalog with anything Quire can show."
"The catalog rejected those credentials."
"Server error %1$s. Try again later."
"Unexpected response %1$s from the catalog."
"Username or password rejected by the server."

"This server asked for a username and password, but it has no catalog at /opds, so it probably isn\'t calibre-web. If it\'s Komga or another OPDS server, go back and enter its full catalog URL instead."
"Unexpected response %1$s from /opds."
"Server returned 200 but the response didn\'t include a token."
"Email or password rejected by the server."
"Unexpected response %1$s from /auth/v1/login."
"That doesn\'t look like a valid URL. Start with http:// or https://."
"We couldn\'t verify the server\'s TLS certificate. Check the URL or your network. (%1$s)"
"We couldn\'t resolve that hostname. Check the URL and your connection."
"The server refused the connection. Is it running and reachable?"
"The server didn\'t respond in time. Check your network and try again."
"The server redirected us somewhere unexpected. Try the redirect\'s final URL directly."
"Couldn\'t reach the server: %1$s"
"How would you like to read?"
"Skip and use Quire offline only"
